title: Mass. agrees to $10 million settlement over death of David Almond, 14
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Local News The Fall River teen starved to death after DCF returned him to his father’s care.
The settlement still needs court approval.

Six years to the day after 14-year-old David Almond died of starvation and neglect in Fall River, Massachusetts agreed Wednesday to a $10 million settlement over the Department of Children and Families’ alleged failure to protect him.
